name: Waves run
notes: The waves mode's run (the second half of the menu; the classic run is scn_run). A 2 x 2-screen arena in one of the 9 worlds, drawn at random by the picker as in the classic run ('world'): the world's own ground, cut down from its classic map, lit in the middle of the dark; its edge darkens smoothly into black. The player can't step into the dark; the monsters come out of it. A monster whose type is the world's is at home (+10% power and speed, -10% recharge), the player included. No floor items lie on the ground when it starts: each level gained opens a menu of 3 cards to choose from, and a fainting monster has a 25% chance to drop one of the classic run's 5 items (at most 3 of each per run, see enm_wave_1). The wave director brings 10 waves, growing from 3 monsters to 24 plus the boss (see prop_waves); clear them all to win, about 10 minutes. Music: the waves theme (mus_waves) until the boss comes, then the boss theme.
